pass-giltighet.title: Check your passport's expiry date
pass-giltighet.hint: Some countries require the passport to be valid for a certain time after your return. Check the country's rules well in advance.

inresekrav.title: Check entry requirements
inresekrav.hint: Visa, travel authorisation or other requirements. Read up with the country's authorities or in the Swedish Foreign Ministry's travel information.

forsakring.title: Check your travel insurance
forsakring.hint: See what your home insurance and payment card cover and whether you need anything more.

eu-kort.title: Bring your EHIC card
eu-kort.hint: The European Health Insurance Card is ordered from Försäkringskassan and is valid for travel within the EU and EEA.

ledigt.title: Arrange time off from work or school

husdjur-blommor.title: Arrange for someone to look after your home

transport-flygplats.title: Decide how you will get to your departure

boka-entreer.title: Book tickets that tend to sell out
boka-entreer.hint: Check the list for your destination. Popular museums and viewpoints may need to be booked in advance.

betalning.title: Check that your cards work abroad
betalning.hint: Review spending limits and region blocks in your bank's app.

mobil.title: Check what your mobile plan costs at the destination

offline.title: Download maps and tickets for offline use

ladda.title: Charge phone, power bank and headphones

sopor.title: Empty the fridge and take out the rubbish
